help:
There are many different achievements you can get by completing various challenges on the server or in specific maps. Remember, you have to be logged in to your account to save achievement completion progress.
Commands: /achievements, /ach, or F1 button - Opens the GUI that shows all achievements on the server and information about collected achievements and their progress. /togglebridges - Shows blips for collected bridges on the minimap and F11 map.
Made by Discoordination, LotsOfS, and Mawfeen
